name: Ella
tagline: Hill-country trains, tea and the Nine Arch Bridge
summary: Ella is a small hill-country village surrounded by tea estates and waterfalls. Arrive on one of the world's most scenic train rides from Kandy, watch the blue train cross the Nine Arch Bridge, hike Little Adam's Peak and Ella Rock, and taste tea at a working estate.
seasonNote: January to March is driest; showers are possible any time in the hills.
arrival: Train from Kandy takes about 6 to 7 hours (book reserved seats early); about 5 hours by car from Colombo's airport.
cashTip: Carry rupees for tuk-tuks and small cafés; cards work in hotels. Tip about 10 percent where no service charge is added.
foodTip: Rice and curry, kottu roti, hoppers and Ceylon tea.
